iis_child_{variant}.short_description: Monthly {variant.long_name} vaccination coverage rate for children ages 2-3 in Tennessee, by county.
iis_child_{variant}.long_description: Vaccination coverage rate from the Tennessee Immunization Information System (TennIIS) for {variant.long_name} among children ages 2-3. Data are reported monthly at the county level. Values of 777 in source data indicate suppressed counts and are set to NA.

iis_school_{variant}.short_description: Monthly {variant.long_name} vaccination coverage rate for children ages 4-6 in Tennessee, by county.
iis_school_{variant}.long_description: Vaccination coverage rate from TennIIS for {variant.long_name} among children ages 4-6. Reported monthly at the county level.

iis_teen_{variant}.short_description: Monthly {variant.long_name} vaccination coverage rate for teens ages 11-17 in Tennessee, by county.
iis_teen_{variant}.long_description: Vaccination coverage rate from TennIIS for {variant.long_name} among adolescents ages 11-17. Reported monthly at the county level.

iis_adult_tdap.short_description: Monthly Tdap vaccination coverage rate for adults ages 18-64 in Tennessee, by county.
iis_adult_tdap.long_description: Vaccination coverage rate from TennIIS for Tdap among adults ages 18-64. Reported monthly at the county level.
iis_adult_tdap.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adults ages 18-64 received Tdap.

iis_senior_{variant}.short_description: Monthly {variant.long_name} vaccination coverage rate for adults 65+ in Tennessee, by county.
iis_senior_{variant}.long_description: Vaccination coverage rate from TennIIS for {variant.long_name} among adults ages 65 and older. Reported monthly at the county level.

tn_tenniis.name: Tennessee Immunization Information System (TennIIS)
tn_tenniis.description: Vaccination coverage rates from the Tennessee Immunization Information System (TennIIS), the state's immunization registry. Data covers five age groups (2-3, 4-6, 11-17, 18-64, 65+) with multiple vaccine types per group, reported monthly at the county level. Rates above 100 or coded as 777 indicate suppressed values.
tn_tenniis.restrictions: Public domain. Tennessee state government data is freely available for public use.
